verdicts.title: Supersymmetry in Random Matrix Theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Supersymmetry is nowadays indispensable for many problems in Random Matrix Theory. It is presented here with an emphasis on conceptual and structural issues. An introduction to supermathematics is given. The Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation as well as its generalization and superbosonization are explained. The supersymmetric non-linear sigma model, Brownian motion in superspace and the color-flavor transformation are discussed.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns supersymmetry techniques in random matrix theory (Hubbard-Stratonovich, sigma models, superbosonization), with no mention of matrix rigidity, sign matrices, Kashin decompositions, or singular-value tail bounds relevant to the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Modular Bourgain-Tzafriri Restricted Invertibility Conjectures and Johnson-Lindenstrauss Flattening Conjecture
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We recently formulated important Modular Bourgain-Tzafriri Restricted Invertibility Conjectures and Modular Johnson-Lindenstrauss Flattening Conjecture in the Appendix of \textit{[arXiv: 2207.12799.v1]}. For the sake of wide accessibility we give a self-contained treatment of them.

It shares the Bourgain-Tzafriri vocabulary but does not engage with the specific rigidity bound claimed.

verdicts.title: A Geometric Perspective on the Singular Value Decomposition
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is an introductory survey, from a geometric perspective, on the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) for real matrices, focusing on the role of the Terracini Lemma. We extend this point of view to tensors, we define the singular space of a tensor as the space spanned by singular vector tuples and we study some of its basic properties.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes an introductory geometric/Terracini-Lemma survey of the SVD and its tensor extension, with no mention of matrix rigidity, sign matrices, Kashin decompositions, or singular-value tail bounds relevant to the conjecture.

verdicts.title: p-adic Grothendieck Inequality, p-adic Johnson-Lindenstrauss Flattening and p-adic Bourgain-Tzafriri Restricted Invertibility Problems
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We formulate p-adic versions of following three: (1) Grothendieck Inequality, (2) Johnson-Lindenstrauss Flattening Lemma, (3) Bourgain-Tzafriri Restricted Invertibility Theorem.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract only formulates p-adic versions of Grothendieck, Johnson-Lindenstrauss, and Bourgain-Tzafriri results, with no statement about sign-matrix rigidity, Kashin splittings of real matrices, or singular-value tail sums.
